title: ProjectContext
description: Universal project tech stack analysis output — covers frontend, backend, or full-stack projects

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the analyzed project root

analysisDate.description: ISO date when analysis was performed

primaryLanguage.description: Main programming language (e.g. TypeScript, Java, Python, Go, C#)

languageVersion.description: Language or compiler version (e.g. TypeScript 5.3.3, Java 21)

runtime.description: Runtime platform (e.g. Node.js, JVM, .NET, CPython, Go)

runtimeVersion.description: Runtime version constraint from manifests or version files

framework.description: Primary framework (e.g. React, Next.js, Express, Spring Boot, Django)

frameworkPlugins.description: Notable framework plugins or extensions (e.g. @vitejs/plugin-react, spring-boot-starter-security)

buildTool.description: Primary build tool (e.g. Vite, Webpack, Maven, Gradle, go build)

packageManager.description: Package manager (e.g. npm, pnpm, yarn, pip, poetry, maven)

entryPoints.description: Application entry point files (e.g. src/main.tsx, src/index.ts, cmd/server/main.go)

apiStyle.description: API paradigm: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, event-driven, or null for frontend-only

apiDocumentation.description: API documentation tooling (e.g. OpenAPI 3.0, GraphQL schema, proto files)

requestValidation.description: Request/response validation library (e.g. Zod, Joi, class-validator, Pydantic)

orm.description: ORM or data access layer (e.g. Prisma, Drizzle, Hibernate, SQLAlchemy)

migrations.description: Migration tool (e.g. Prisma Migrate, Flyway, Alembic, Drizzle Kit)

messaging.description: Message brokers or event systems (e.g. Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, NATS)

jobSchedulers.description: Background job / scheduling libraries (e.g. BullMQ, Celery, Quartz)

authentication.description: Auth mechanism (e.g. JWT, OAuth2, OIDC, session-based)

securityMiddleware.description: Security middleware or libraries (e.g. helmet, cors, Spring Security)

logging.description: Logging library (e.g. Pino, Winston, Logback, structlog)

healthChecks.description: Health check mechanism (e.g. Spring Actuator, custom /health endpoint)

stylingMethod.description: Primary styling approach (e.g. Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, styled-components, SCSS)

cssFramework.description: CSS component framework (e.g. Tailwind, Bootstrap, MUI, Ant Design, Chakra UI)

stateManagement.description: Client-side state library (e.g. Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Pinia, MobX)

routing.description: Client-side routing library (e.g. React Router, Vue Router, TanStack Router)

formHandling.description: Form library (e.g. React Hook Form, Formik)

httpClient.description: HTTP client library (e.g. Axios, TanStack Query, SWR, fetch)

unitTestFramework.description: Unit test framework (e.g. Vitest, Jest, JUnit 5, pytest)

integrationTestTools.description: Integration / contract test tools (e.g. Supertest, Testcontainers, WireMock, Pact)

e2eTestFramework.description: E2E test framework (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, Puppeteer)

testUtilities.description: Auxiliary test utilities (e.g. Testing Library, jsdom, happy-dom, Faker)

coverageTool.description: Code coverage tool (e.g. v8, istanbul, JaCoCo)

linter.description: Primary linter (e.g. ESLint, Ruff, golangci-lint, Checkstyle)

formatter.description: Code formatter (e.g. Prettier, Black, gofmt, dotnet format)

staticAnalysis.description: Static analysis tools (e.g. SonarQube, SpotBugs, mypy, bandit)

typeChecking.description: Type checker if separate from language (e.g. TypeScript, mypy, Flow)

kubernetes.description: K8s deployment tooling (e.g. Helm, Kustomize, plain manifests)

cicd.description: CI/CD platform (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure Pipelines)

devCommands.description: Key dev scripts from package.json scripts or Makefile targets (e.g. {"dev": "vite", "build": "tsc && vite build"})

devTools.description: Developer experience tools (e.g. hot reload, dev proxy, storybook)

gitHooks.description: Git hook tooling (e.g. Husky + lint-staged, pre-commit, Lefthook)

envVariables.description: Known environment variable names from .env.example or documentation

projectStructure.description: Tree representation of key directories (2-3 levels deep)

keyProdDependencies.description: 5-15 most significant production dependencies with versions

keyDevDependencies.description: 5-15 most significant development dependencies with versions

patterns.description: Notable architectural patterns, conventions, or observations (e.g. 'Layered architecture: routes → controllers → services → repository', 'Monorepo with Turborepo')
